newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Lisnave has good order book.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Lisnave has good order book.

text.p: Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais has a healthy order book, a company official said.
"Lisnave is guaranteed a brisk rate of activity in terms of orders," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
He said the company was presently repairing 21 ships.
The official declined to give the value of the order book or to forecast first half results.
Lisnave shares have strengthened recently amid confidence over the level of orders, dealers said.
Lisnave stood at 315 escudos, up 42, in volume of 300,577 at 1437 GMT.
